title: Illustrative synchronous new-view decision mismatch
summary: Illustrative only: the backend callback appears to require a synchronous decision while hostproto specifies a bounded asynchronous resolution.
raw_observation: The native callback returns a view handle or null before control returns to the event loop.
normalized_effect: The adapter cannot emit view.open_requested and later apply an allow decision without holding or replaying the native request.
decision: Do not add an engine-specific chrome path. Reduce the callback behavior and determine whether a safe bounded holding mechanism exists; otherwise declare the capability unsupported for the pinned adapter.
